editorial:
Imagine moving into a new house only to find out a grumpy ghost is already living there. That is exactly what happens to Kevin, a kid who turns this spooky discovery into a goldmine by posting videos of the ghost, Ernest, on social media. Instead of a scary horror flick, you get a lighthearted ride that feels like a family adventure. The vibe is very upbeat, focusing more on the odd-couple friendship between a tech-savvy boy and a ghost from the past than on actual scares. It is the kind of movie you can put on for a Friday night when you just want to relax and smile.

What really works here is the chemistry between the leads and the fast pace that keeps you from getting bored. While the plot gets a bit wild when the CIA shows up, it stays fun throughout. Some might find the story a little predictable, but it is mostly just a feel-good tale. It is a perfect pick for families who want a little bit of mystery without the nightmares.
endingExplained: At the end, Kevin and Ernest discover that Ernest was actually a CIA agent who died during a secret mission. After a big showdown with the government agents who want to capture him, Ernest finally finds peace. He says a heartfelt goodbye to Kevin and his family before crossing over to the afterlife. It wraps up with a sweet message about letting go and the lasting bond between the two unlikely friends.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family comedies with a supernatural twist.
